title: Aureline M5 artifact-lineage-panel component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the artifact-lineage-panel family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). An artifact lineage panel names what a generated artifact is and how completely its lineage resolves so a panel never hides a broken or unknown lineage and always names its upstream and downstream. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
